review.summary: Requires manual interior/material recovery: cutaways show two intact shelves in cached decoded geometry, but the standard inner-face removal loses the upper shelf and distorts the lower one. A cache-verified postprocessing-only candidate preserving inner faces restores both without AI resampling. The glass remains to be reviewed as material, not mistaken for an empty opaque housing.

issues.problem: Standard export loses essential internal shelf geometry; use separately reviewed recovered geometry and glass material correction.
